name: Translate to Catalan
description: A voice speaks what you say in Catalan. Needs speech recognition and AI voices. Downloads a 135 MB translation model and voice once, when you ask for it; translating then happens on this PC.
credits: English to Catalan model from the Argos Translate package index: OPUS-MT (Tiedemann & Thottingal, 2020), CC BY 4.0. Voice: Piper voice ca_ES-upc_ona-medium from rhasspy/piper-voices, CC BY-SA 3.0.
